[[File:Winged_jet_backpack_clone.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A clone jet trooper wearing the backpack]]
The '''winged jet backpack''' was a variation of [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] worn by [[Clone paratrooper/Legends|clone sky troopers]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The model was equipped with wings that extended before flight and was armed with two [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|161|sky trooper}}</ref> The wings were emblazoned with two [[Republic crest/Legends|Galactic Roundels]].<ref name="GGAR">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref>
